sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Soul Magic (touching the head to seize the soul)
spells.note: The search summaries: his Soul Magic needs a touch on the target's head.

spells.name: Soul Magic (severing the soul)
spells.note: Design: the wiki lists Soul Magic spells only as unnamed.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Paladin Conversion
spells.note: KEPT page, locked to Lucius since 1.44.0: he turns people into his Paladins by remaking their souls.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Paladin Recall
spells.note: KEPT page, locked to Lucius since 1.44.0: he calls his Paladins back.

spells.name: Soul Magic (a cold touch on the soul)
spells.note: Design: a basic soul attack of the shared Soul book.

spells.name: Soul Magic (draining a soul)
spells.note: Design: a basic soul attack of the shared Soul book.

spells.name: Soul Magic (soul wisps)
spells.note: Design: an existing page of the Soul book.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Imprint of Ideals
spells.note: His Soul Magic can plant a belief in a mind and change a person's ideals (manga ch.333 to 335 as covered by news sites).

spells.name: Soul Magic (a ward of souls)
spells.note: Design: guarding the souls of his allies.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Soul Mend
spells.note: Chapter 333 hints that his Soul Magic can bring back and mend the dead (speculative in the sources).

spells.name: Soul Magic (a guard of souls)
spells.note: Design: an existing generic page of the Soul book.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Grimoire Tower Link
spells.note: Chapter 379: he connects to the grimoire towers and casts the spells of dead mages.

planned.name: Bone Bullets, Time Magic, Gravity, Body, Blood
planned.note: Attributes he gained later by absorbing his siblings and a contract; each lives in its own book.

planned.name: Clone creation (Soul, Body, Blood and Bone together)
planned.note: A union of four attributes; no page.

notes: His CanonBook entry changed from Dark Magic to Soul Magic (the series' attribute; the mod has a Soul book since 1.44.0): a grimoire already bound with the old pair (DARK, lucius) keeps working as before. Soul Magic has no named spells on the wiki, so only the two Paladin pages are canon; the other pages are marked design. Pages 15 (batch 3): the entries after the first ones are the new shared pages of the book (and some older pages of it), none exclusive, so the basic grimoire keeps showing them too.
